title: prunus insititia subsp. cerea
intro: Prunus insititia subsp. cerea, commonly known as damson, is a plant species in the Prunus genus. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree, rich in antioxidants and offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of P. insititia subsp. cerea include cardiovascular protection, antioxidant activity, and potential anti-cancer effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal and health-promoting properties.
